title: Spanish Omelette with Aromatic Flair
description: A classic Spanish omelette with an aromatic twist, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Large eggs for a fluffy omelette

ingredients.name: Aromatic
ingredients.notes: Sauteed onions add an aromatic flavor

ingredients.name: Stone Ground Spanish
ingredients.notes: Add a smoky flavor with Spanish smoked paprika

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Season with salt to bring out the flavors

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of black pepper for extra flavor

instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of oil.
Add the onions and sauté until they're translucent and fragrant.
Add the smoked paprika and stir for a minute.
Pour in the eggs and let them cook for a minute.
Use a spatula to gently lift the edges of the omelette and tilt the pan so the uncooked egg can flow underneath.
Once the eggs are almost set, use the spatula to fold the omelette in half.
Cook for another minute and then slide the omelette onto a plate.
